message.reasoning_content:
Price now: base after 2 sold =9, +boom 2 =11 alashi per unit. Buy 1 costs 11, resets counter back... After buy, next sell price higher. We have 16.25 cash, poor. Buying 1 unit costs 11 alashi, can sell later at higher price? Buy moves sold counter backward; next market sale price after counter back to 1 → price 10+2=12. Buying costs 11, selling later yields 12+ — modest gain but cash tied, devaluation next rounds cash→62%. Actually cash shrinks, so converting cash to goods is good! Buy converts 11 cash (would devalue) into goods. But goods sold later via sell_credit earns promissory which is added to cash... promissory added then devalued next round too. Still, buying is favorable: spend 11 devaluing cash, gain good.

Buy.
